'''''Aichryson divaricatum''''' is a species of succulent plant of the family [[Crassulaceae]] [[endemic]] to [[Madeira]].<ref name=catalogue/>

==Description==
It is usually smooth and glabrous, {{convert|4|to|30|cm|in}} tall and green. It has a dark green, ascending stem. Flowers are {{convert|6|-|10|mm|in}} in diagonal, most with 7-petals, in dense summits. Petals are {{convert|3|-|5|mm|in}}, ovate, short aristated, pale golden yellow, with a central dorsal rib.<ref name=uma>{{cite web |title=Aichryson divaricatum (Aiton) Praeger |url=http://www3.uma.pt/biopolis/planta.php?id=629 |website=www3.uma.pt |access-date=28 November 2020}}</ref>

==Distribution==
The species is endemic to [[Madeira Island]] and [[Desertas Islands]] and is commonly found on rocks over [[levadas]], cliffs, walls, ravines and sometimes on tree trunks between {{convert|100|and|1000|m|ft}} in altitude.<ref name=uma />
